And that is why, over the years, we worked on building that trust. We ensure that every product sold through our offline/online stores are checked for their authenticity, quality, and compliance with the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization, the national regulatory body for Indian pharmaceuticals and medical devices.\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e100% Genuine Medicine From Apollo Pharmacy\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003eAll medicines/healthcare products sold on Apollo Pharmacy are procured from our sister company - Apollo Pharmacy, with a reputation of selling only 100% genuine products.
